axes_source: Read from data/brands/cursor.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #F54E00 and the canvas #F7F7F4; contrast from the ink #26251E on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #F54E00; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 0, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #F54E00 reaches 3.28:1 on the canvas #F7F7F4, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
name: Cursor
